A '''guard dog''' is an aggressive [[Dog (race)|dog]]. Guard dogs drop only [[bones]]. They can be slain for a [[Dogs (Slayer assignment)|dogs slayer assignment]] assigned by a [[Slayer Master]]. For lower-level players, guard dogs can be tough to melee, as they can hit frequently, but these players can easily attack them from safe spots using ranged, magic, or long-range melee weapons like [[halberds]]. One safe spot is through the fence of the north side of the [[McGrubor's Wood]]. Another spot is behind the mushrooms located on the south-west corner of the wood. Players wielding a halberd can safely attack them from any side of the fence.

Guard dogs may also be purchased at level 74 [[Construction]] to guard a player's [[Dungeon (player-owned house)|dungeon]], see [[guard dog (player-owned house)]].
